plugins\/sms4g\/desktop\/php\/sms4g.php.Autorise la réception de messages de num: Allows messages from unknown numbers to be received. Interactions are always disabled for these numbers. The received message and the sender's number will be available via commands, just as with any other message.
plugins\/sms4g\/desktop\/php\/sms4g.php.Cette option est dangereuse car cela va: This option is dangerous because it will automatically add a command associated with the number whenever a message is received from an unknown number.
plugins\/sms4g\/desktop\/php\/sms4g.php.N'activez cette option que si vous êtes: Enable this option only if you are certain you are willing to accept this risk.
plugins\/sms4g\/desktop\/php\/sms4g.php.Permet d'ajouter automatiquement un numé: Automatically adds an unknown number to the command list when a message is received.
plugins\/sms4g\/desktop\/php\/sms4g.php.Si sur le même équipement vous activez l: If you enable interactions on the same device, this means that anyone will be able to start interacting with your Jeedom.

plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.0 : désactivé (par défaut). Le modem s'e: 0: disabled (default). The modem sends itself an SMS to verify receipt of SMS messages and acknowledgments. One SMS is used per test. Minimum: 1 hour.
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.0 = illimité. Certains opérateurs limite: 0 = unlimited. Some carriers limit the number of text messages that can be combined to form a long message—specify the observed limit if necessary
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.115200 convient à la plupart des modems: 115200 is compatible with most modems; 9600 may be useful with an older modem if there are communication issues
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Affiche la connexion du modem, son enreg: Displays the modem's connection status, its registration on the mobile network, and signal quality (modem device values)
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Attente des parties d'un SMS long (s): Waiting for parts of a long text message(s)
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Au-delà de ce nombre de tentatives infru: If the number of failed attempts exceeds this limit, the daemon restarts completely
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Autorise l'envoi de commandes AT au mode: Enables sending AT commands to the modem from Jeedom using the “AT Command” command for the Modem device (the result appears in “AT Status” and “AT Response”). Dangerous commands are rejected by the daemon. Enable this temporarily for diagnostic purposes.
This change applies to the entire system.
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Ce délai double à chaque nouvel échec, j: This time limit doubles with each subsequent failure, up to the maximum time limit listed below
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Cocher cette case désactivera les messag: Checking this box will disable plugin update notifications in the message center
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Durée pendant laquelle le plugin attend: The amount of time the plugin waits for missing parts of a long SMS. After this time has elapsed, the message is discarded (it is not partially transmitted) and an error message appears in Jeedom. Default: 300 seconds.
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Durée pendant laquelle le plugin retente: The amount of time the plugin will retry sending an SMS that could not be sent (modem disconnected, no network, etc.). After this time has elapsed, the attempt is abandoned and the status changes to “Expired.” Minimum: 1 minute. Default: 60 minutes.
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Délai avant l'envoi d'une réponse (s): Time before a response is sent (s)
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Délai laissé au modem entre la fin de l': The delay allowed for the modem between the end of sending one SMS and the start of the next. 0: no pause (default).
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Délai minimal entre la réception d'un SM: Minimum delay between receiving a text message and sending a reply. If a reply is sent too quickly, the sender's text message remains in the "sending" status on their phone. 0: none. Default: 3 seconds.
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Interactions : ignorer les SMS de plus d: Interactions: Ignore text messages older than (minutes)
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Intervalle entre deux relevés du signal: The interval between two signal readings and their transmission over the mobile network (at least 5 seconds). A value that is too low may result in some instability.
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.La carte SIM ne connaît pas son numéro :: The SIM card does not recognize its number: enter it manually
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Laisser vide si votre carte SIM n'a pas: Leave blank if your SIM card does not have a PIN
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Le délai entre deux tentatives double à: The interval between two attempts doubles with each failure, without ever exceeding this value. Default: 300 seconds
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Le démon devra être redémarré après la m: The daemon will need to be restarted after this setting is changed
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Le démon récupère le statut de livraison: The daemon retrieves the delivery status of each sent message: “Status” then changes from “Sent” to “Delivered” (or “Not Delivered”), and “Delivered” is set to 1 only in this case (when there are multiple recipients and all have received the message). Without this option, “Status” remains “Sent” and “Delivered” does not change.
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Les dépendances devront être relancées a: The dependencies will need to be restarted after this setting is saved
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.ModemManager va être désactivé et arrêté: ModemManager will be disabled and shut down
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Permet de forcer l'installation des mise: Allows you to force the installation of system updates
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Permet de forcer la réinitialisation de: Allows you to force a reset of the Python environment used by the plugin
Forces a reset of the Venv environment used by the plugin
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Privilégiez un port \/dev\/serial\/by-id: Use a /dev/serial/by-id/... port (stable) rather than a /dev/ttyUSB* port (the number may change after a reboot or reconnection)
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Recommandé si votre opérateur a coupé la: Recommended if your carrier has disabled 2G/3G: this prevents the modem from wasting time searching for those networks. Please note that if 4G coverage is unavailable in a given location, the modem will not fall back to 2G/3G. Only supported on SimCom modems (e.g., SIM7600G-H)
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Redémarre le modem (environ 30 secondes: Restarts the modem (about 30 seconds without service), no more than once per hour. Without this option, a failure is simply reported.
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Redémarrer le modem si l'auto-test échou: Restart the modem if the self-test fails
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Service système de gestion des modems po: Internet access modem management service (unrelated to sending/receiving text messages): may conflict with access to the modem's serial port when connecting or disconnecting
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Un SMS reçu avec plus de retard que ce d: An SMS received later than this time limit (modem disconnected, daemon stopped, etc.) is no longer executed as a command: there is no interaction or response to a pending query, to avoid executing an outdated command. The “Message” and “Sender” commands are still updated (a scenario triggered by these commands must therefore take the message’s age into account), and the SMS is logged. 0: never ignored. Default: 10 minutes. The age is calculated based on the SMS center’s date: the Jeedom clock must be set to the correct time.
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Utilisé seulement par l'auto-test. « Dét: Used only by the self-test. "Detect" the area code on the SIM card if it is known; otherwise, enter it (+33...).
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Version de PyEnv utilisée par le Plugin: PyEnv version used by the plugin (Please specify on Community)
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Version de Python utilisée par le Plugin: Python version used by the plugin (Please specify on the Community)
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.Version du Plugin (A indiquer sur Commun: Plugin Version (Please specify on the Community)
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.[ATTENTION] Ne changez ce paramètre qu'e: [WARNING] Do not change this setting unless necessary. (Default = 55115)
plugins\/sms4g\/plugin_info\/configurati.À laisser vide dans le cas normal : le c: Leave blank under normal circumstances: the SIM's SMS center is used. Enter only if sending fails with error CMS 330 (SMS center not defined): your carrier's SMS gateway number, for example +33695000695 (on Android, enter the code #*#*4636#*#* to display it). An invalid number is ignored and logged in the daemon's log.
